GameDefinition.name: GameDefinition
GameDefinition.description: Represents information about a game that's offered as a reward to customers and loyalty program members.

EndDate.description: The date until when the game can be offered.

ExpirationPeriod.description: The number of days or months a game remains valid for play after it’s assigned.

ExpirationPeriodUnit.description: The unit of measure for the ExpirationPeriod field.

IsGameAssignmentRequired.description: Indicates whether customers or loyalty program members are eligible to play the game only if they’re assigned the game (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

StartDate.description: The date from which the game can be offered.

TimeoutDuration.description: The duration for which the game is valid for after a participant starts to play it. The value is specified in seconds.
